_readme: The token tree build_tokens.py reads. Each leaf is {type, value, source}; value is a computed measurement and source names where it was read (raw/components-computed.json unless noted). Written from the 2026-11-10 measurement run over aesop.com (US storefront).

ink.source: computed color/borderColor of nearly every measured component (raw/components-computed.json)
ink.description: The house ink: text, keylines, borders, the primary fill. Not pure black.

inkSoft.description: A softened ink used on the sign-in submit.

cream.source: computed backgroundColor of filter-panel, cart-panel, search-field, newsletter-field defaults and color of add-to-cart/hero-cta/footer-link defaults (raw/components-computed.json)
cream.description: The Aesop cream: page ground, field fills, and the light ink on dark surfaces.

creamDark.source: computed borderTopColor of search-button, search-close defaults (raw/components-computed.json)
creamDark.description: The deeper cream of secondary fills and hairlines.

creamAlt.source: computed backgroundColor on interior surface sections (raw/components-computed.json)
creamAlt.description: A mid cream for inset bands.

creamHover.description: The light ink of the sign-in submit.

muted.source: computed color of disabled/muted text nodes (raw/components-computed.json)

amber.source: computed color of tile-badge default (New addition, Beloved formulation) and 'Learn more' links (raw/components-computed.json)
amber.description: The one accent: a tannin amber for badges, promos and inline links.

black.source: computed color of stores-title, m-menu-button, m-nav-item (raw/components-computed.json)
black.description: True black, used sparingly: locator title, mobile drawer items.

white.source: computed backgroundColor on a few interior controls (raw/components-computed.json)

keyline.source: computed borderTopColor of newsletter-field, store-search, login-email defaults (raw/components-computed.json)

sans.source: computed fontFamily of almost every measured text node (raw/components-computed.json)
sans.description: Suisse Intl carries the site; the guide renders the Helvetica fallback.

medium.source: computed fontFamily of nav-link, hero-cta, add-to-cart, tile-badge, filter-toggle (raw/components-computed.json)
medium.description: The medium cut, used for nav items, buttons and badges.

display.description: Circular Std, seen on the PDP product title.

12.source: utility nav, breadcrumbs, small print fontSize

14.source: nav-link, footer-link, field text, buttons fontSize

regular.source: computed fontWeight of most measured text

bold.source: computed fontWeight of topnav-link, product-card-name, footer-col-title, search-button

utility.$description: 12/14.4 bold utility labels in the top row.

navLabel.$description: 14/16.8 medium for nav items, buttons, CTA cards.

title.$description: 24/30 page and product titles; the search field sets the same size.

display.$description: 30/30 the Find a store display heading.

none.source: borderTopLeftRadius of almost every measured component (raw/components-computed.json)

small.source: radius on a handful of inner controls (raw/components-computed.json)

medium.source: radius on a few cards/dialog edges (raw/components-computed.json)

hairline.description: Every rule and keyline is 1px; several are drawn as 1px-spread box-shadows rather than borders.

top.source: rendered height of the utility row at 1440 (header default, raw/components-computed.json)

field.source: rendered height of newsletter-field, store-search, login-email, search-field

button.source: rendered height of add-to-cart, hero-cta, login-submit

hero.source: rendered height of the home hero band at 1440

x.source: computed paddingLeft of add-to-cart, hero-cta, login-submit
computed paddingLeft of newsletter-field, search-button; 35px on store-search (icon inset)

color.source: computed outlineColor on measured focus-visible states; the width never paints, so no ring shows (raw/components-computed.json)
color.description: Aesop draws no visible focus ring on the measured controls: keyboard focus lands, but outlineWidth stays 0 and no ring is painted.

width.source: computed outlineWidth on every focus-visible measurement

hover.source: computed transitionDuration of topnav-link, signup-link, cart-button (raw/components-computed.json)
hover.description: Utility-nav colour changes ease over half a second.

mobile.source: the width at which the burger menu replaces the nav row

light.$description: The only theme aesop.com paints; semantic roles alias core.

page.source: computed backgroundColor of the page surfaces (fields, panels, dialogs)

surface.source: computed borderTopColor/secondary fill of header controls

header.source: computed backgroundColor of header and m-header defaults: the translucent cream the transparent header settles to

primary.source: computed color of nearly every measured text node

onDark.source: computed color of footer-link, footer-col-title, add-to-cart, hero-cta on dark fills

accent.source: computed color of tile-badge and promo links

black.source: computed color of stores-title and mobile drawer items

primary.description: The ink bar: ADD TO CART and the dark CTAs.

primaryText.source: computed color of add-to-cart on the ink fill

outline.source: computed borderTopColor/color of hero-cta: the cream-bordered CTA card over photography

default.source: computed borderTopColor/outlineColor of keylines on controls

light.source: computed borderTopColor of hero-cta and footer links on dark

ring.source: computed outlineColor on focused controls; no painted ring was observed
